articles.title: Bullet Banshee puts a survivor-like spin on classic shoot 'em up action
articles.summary: Bullet Banshee is a vertical-scrolling shoot 'em up that blends in the survivor-like bullet heaven mechanics for upgrades to great effect. Disclosure: a key was provided to our Steam Curator .

articles.title: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication
articles.summary: A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.312
articles.summary: Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place.

articles.title: Apple releases two new real-life Apple Watch stories, including a life-saving alert
articles.summary: Apple’s YouTube channel shared two new videos today from its “True Apple Watch Story” series, highlighting how the device helped save one woman’s life and transform another person’s fitness journey.

articles.title: Gemini Notebook for Android, iOS adds built-in audio recorder
articles.summary: Google first announced the audio recorder in September, and it’s now widely rolling out today on Android and iOS . Force stop the app if it’s not live on your device.

articles.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse Studios hit by cyberattack
articles.summary: Another recent incident, Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse Studios revealed they've been hit in a cyberattack. We don't exactly know many details from it, but they've announced it publicly so it must be relatively serious.

articles.title: Alibaba's latest Qwen models routed some requests through company servers, researchers find
articles.summary: Researchers Ozerov and Ravi then ran the same tests on competing models, including DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash, Kimi-K3.1-Pro, GLM-5.3, and Hy4-preview. While some of those models fell back to public proxies like r.jina.ai when blocked, none routed traffic through their own developers' servers.

articles.title: 8K60 / 4K120 HDMI Splitter – VRR & PS3/Streaming Box Compatible
articles.summary: This HDMI splitter can accept up to 8K60, supports true VRR, works with PS3/Streaming boxes and is fully compatible with MiSTer FPGA, even in direct video mode.

articles.title: SLAM Navigation For an Arduino Powered Car
articles.summary: The robot is a built on a small plastic chassis, with one gear motor per drive wheel. Running the show is an Arduino Uno R4 Wi-Fi, paired with the Sensor Shield 5.0 and an L298N motor driver board.

articles.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released its newest world model, Genie 4, in research preview on Tuesday. The latest model generates the most photorealistic and interactive worlds yet, allowing users to type prompts mid-simulation to change the scene.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot supports server-to-server authentication
articles.summary: GitHub Copilot now supports server-to-server authentication for GitHub Apps installed on organizations, available in public preview. Services and agents built with the GitHub Copilot SDK can now make requests on behalf of an organization without relying on a signed-in user’s credentials.

articles.title: Someone is bringing Android Auto back to your phone’s screen, and it actually works [Gallery]
articles.summary: When Android Auto first debuted, it didn’t require a fancy display in your car. It just worked on your phone screen and, now, someone is bringing that functionality back after Google killed it.

articles.summary: Divine Frequency is a new GZDoom / UZDoom powered FPS fever dream, one where you get to experience the total collapse of reality. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: OpenAI's Ted Sanders shares a rule of thumb for picking the right GPT-model
articles.summary: OpenAI's Ted Sanders has categorized the new GPT-6.1 Terra and explained how the company names its language models. According to Sanders, model performance is multidimensional.

articles.title: Counting the Bandages: On measuring the time that AI saves
articles.summary: I consider what it means for AI assistance to save time. I contrast a stopwatch view, on which time saved is whatever the clock records, with a ledger view, on which it is a counterfactual that has to be read next to the errors the work lets through, and I argue for the latter.

articles.title: Enhancing Deep Learning Model Performance through Data Generation Strategies: Classification of Olive Tree Diseases
articles.summary: Deep learning models are highly effective in a wide range of domains, particu larly in plant disease diagnosis. However, their performance is often limited by challenges such as insufficient data and class imbalance.

articles.title: Retiring BSD-Compress Proposed For Linux PPP Network Code
articles.summary: A patch has been proposed to remove the BSD-Compress support from the Linux kernel for the Linux networking point-to-point protocol (PPP) due to being unmaintained and having fundamental issues with the code that can lead to a fatal error.

articles.title: Wine Merges Support For MESA_map_buffer_client_pointer To Improve WoW64 32-bit OpenGL
articles.summary: An initiative led by CodeWeavers this year has come to fruition for improving OpenGL support with WoW64 for bettering Windows 32-bit application/game support while using 64-bit system libraries.

articles.title: Ubuntu firmware HWE will prevent issues on older kernel
articles.summary: Ubuntu developer Juerg Haefliger noted that a firmware backport for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, intended for its Linux 7.0 HWE kernel, introduced two AMD regressions for users running the Linux 6.9 GA kernel.

articles.title: Linux 7.4 Introduces DMA-BUF Support To I/O Path With IO_uring
articles.summary: Merged today for the ongoing Linux 7.4 merge window is the infrastructure for enabling DMA-BUF support in the kernel's I/O path with the wonderful IO_uring framework.
